name: better-session-view
description: Session manager for large Ableton Live sets.

scripts.build: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:ui && npm run build:device
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bridge,lom,ui,device -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.node.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.v8.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite --config ui/vite.config.ts" "node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --watch-path=tools tools/build-device.ts"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p bridge/tsconfig.v8.json --noEmit && tsc -p core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p ui/tsconfig.json
